message:
🚀 HexPlayer v1.1.2 is here!

✨ What's New:
• Custom headers now work on playlists, quality lists & video segments (even on different servers)
• Auto mode plays all MPD / ClearKey streams on Bitmovin
• Default player engine is now Auto (Shaka only when you select it)
• Brand new modern loading spinner

⚡ Faster stream start with smarter engine preloading
🐛 Fixed streams that failed because Referer / User-Agent headers were missing, plus CORS fixes & more
